caption: The drawing depicts a single figure of a woman positioned centrally on a plain, light beige background. The woman has short, black curly hair and a light-toned face with red lips and red circles on her cheeks. She is wearing a long, dark green dress with voluminous sleeves and a patterned, light brown apron tied with a wide, orange-brown waistband. White ruffles are visible at the neckline and cuffs. Her feet, visible below the hem of the dress, are in red shoes and white stockings. The overall composition is simple, with the figure standing upright and arms slightly angled downwards, taking up the central portion of the image, and there is no additional background detail or objects aside from a small signature in the lower right corner.
title: Old American Wooden Doll
